regime_context: Canada/TSX detector shows a broad (56% eligible), two-leader rotation with Base Metals & Copper (score 1.74, mean-revert, not crowded) narrowly ahead of Oil & Gas Producers (1.55, mixed durability, not crowded). Absolute-trend gate is validated for this market (gate_helps true), so the staying-power leg matters; momentum ranks themselves are a focus lens only. Track record shows 65.6% hit rate on n=96 but only 34.4% direction accuracy — directional calls have been weak, so I keep conviction low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Base Metals & Copper (XBM.TO) can hold its #1 rank while its durability_bar (0.51) stays below Oil & Gas (0.64) and its hurst_tag stays mean-revert — if XEG.TO's score overtakes XBM.TO's by 0.25+ on two consecutive detector prints, the two-leader structure would read as a confirmed handoff to Oil & Gas.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is eligible, ranks #2, and shows the strongest durability_bar (0.64) among leading themes plus the broadest breadth (0.643) in the eligible set — a trend-following, vol-aware read of where leadership is concentrating, not a return forecast. Its hurst_tag is 'mixed' rather than mean-revert, and crowding is not flagged.
evidence: absolute-trend gate validated for this market
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0, so the #2 rank carries no momentum alpha; breadth/durability are coincident texture, not forward edge. Direction accuracy on this desk has been poor (34.4%).

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its own 50-day level while XBM.TO still advances, before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: ZEB.TO is the only eligible theme tagged 'trend' in the current period and sits mid-pack (rank 5, positive score 0.58) with a solid durability_bar (0.60) and no crowding. A trend-following, absolute-trend-gated tilt toward a less-extended financials theme, not a momentum call.
evidence: hurst_tag 'trend' (only eligible theme with this tag)
theses.dissent: Breadth is weak (0.286), meaning few constituents are confirming; a trend label on thin participation can persist on index weighting rather than genuine flow.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO breaks below its recent swing low and XEG.TO makes a new high over the same window

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: XIT.TO is the only eligible theme flagged crowded (crowding_z 1.22, crowded true) despite a negative score (-0.205) and falling rank (9). Crowding here is a size-down caution only, never a short — but for a fresh lean, the combination of negative momentum and crowding argues against initiating exposure.
evidence: crowded true, crowding_z 1.22 (only crowded eligible theme)
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge and the theme is not to be faded on that flag; breadth (0.600) is actually healthy, so this could be a consolidation rather than a top.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO clears its recent range high and crowding_z drops below 0.5 before the check-by date
